<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<title>Cream Painting Cards — Starter Template</title>
<!--
MASTER DESIGN RULES FOR THE NEXT AI:
1. Single-file/offline HTML; one slide visible at a time, never vertical scrolling.
2. The painting card contains ONLY: original PNG FIRST, then a cream caption strip with a large centered serif painting title BELOW the image.
3. Do NOT add an Act/section heading above painting. Do NOT add small title above painting.
4. Preserve full original image bytes inside data:image/png;base64; never crop, convert, recompress or replace.
5. The title and introduction cards come first. EVERY major chapter or Act/section heading from the textbook has its own dedicated section-card, immediately BEFORE that section’s painting cards. The heading must be LEFT-ALIGNED on its own cream card—never added above the painting.
6. Keep cream page #faf8f2, warm white paper #fffdf9, subtle 1px border/shadow.
7. Fixed bottom navigation: previous / page count / next. Arrow keys, swipe, Home/End.
8. For every new Act/major section, add one section.section-card with its exact source heading. Next duplicate section.painting-card for each relevant painting, provide original Base64 PNG, and put its descriptive title ONLY in .painting-caption h2 BELOW the image.
9. Replace sample chapter text and example paintings; keep exact CSS/JS and layout patterns. Never keep example content in the finished chapter.
10. Verify: heading cards immediately precede their paintings; headings are LEFT aligned; artwork slides contain only image first and title BELOW; all image bytes decode byte-identically; no external dependencies, clipping, crop, or scroll.
 11. RAW PASTED PDF TEXT IS NOT APPROVED FORMATTING: reconstruct natural
     paragraphs and true section/list boundaries from content, not page wraps.
     Ignore artificial line endings; never turn every source line into a slide.
 12. Remove only certain repetitive page furniture (e.g. isolated repeated
     Laxmikanth book/author headers), standalone page numbers/footers,
     clear footnote-reference digits, and accidental extraction whitespace.
     Preserve substantive headings, dates, numerals, meanings and order.
     If an apparent artifact is ambiguous, KEEP it and flag it.
 13. Split words repaired only when clear; keep genuine hyphens and names.
     For real line-ending compounds, Governor- + General => Governor-General.
 14. Clean source BEFORE making slides. Intro text may be concise but must be
     grounded in full cleaned source. Section-card headings reflect real
     source structure, not accidental running heads; preserve their wording.
 15. Do not put textbook prose into painting cards. Never add <br> to force
     PDF wrap points in headings, intro or captions; use responsive CSS.
 16. Keep ALL source material in the separate reading textbook, not slides.
     After cleaning, audit source content for unintended omissions and
     stray duplicated headers/footnotes. These new rules override any
     earlier instruction to preserve PDF line breaks exactly.
-->
<style>
:root{color-scheme:light;--page:#faf8f2;--paper:#fffdf9;--ink:#252d31;--soft:#657076;--line:#dfddd5;--accent:#9d633d}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;background:var(--page);color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
/* The deck is one fixed-height viewport, never a vertically scrolling webpage. */
.deck{height:calc(100vh - 64px);height:calc(100dvh - 64px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px 12px 0;min-width:0}
.slide{display:none;min-width:0;max-width:100%;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(49,44,36,.08)}
.slide.active{display:block}
/* A generous height reserve guarantees the FULL image and title fit above the controls.
   The aspect ratio below is the display ratio, not a change to the embedded PNG bytes. */
.slide.painting-card{
 width:min(1204px,calc(100vw - 32px),calc((100dvh - 210px)*1.7768331562));
 overflow:visible;
}
.artwork{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--paper)}
.artwork img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain}
/* IMPORTANT: image first; title below. This white/cream title strip is attached to image. */
.painting-caption{background:var(--paper);padding:19px 24px 24px;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid #ece6db}
.painting-caption h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(15px,2.0vw,28px);line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
/* Title and introduction are separate slides, not headers on painting slides. */
.slide.title-card,.slide.intro-card{width:min(1120px,calc(100vw - 32px),calc((100dvh - 145px)*1.60));aspect-ratio:1.60;display:none;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:7% 9%;position:relative}
.slide.title-card.active,.slide.intro-card.active{display:flex}

/* An Act or major section heading belongs on its OWN card, never on painting slides. */
.slide.section-card{
 width:min(1120px,calc(100vw - 32px),calc((100dvh - 145px)*1.60));
 aspect-ratio:1.60;
 display:none;
 flex-direction:column;
 justify-content:center;
 align-items:flex-start;
 padding:8% 10%;
 position:relative;
}
.slide.section-card.active{display:flex}
.section-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4%;border:1px solid #d6cbbc;pointer-events:none}
.section-card h2{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(27px,5.25vw,74px);letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.12;max-width:830px;text-align:left;margin:0 0 27px;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.section-card .section-rule{height:2px;width:62px;background:var(--accent)}
.title-card::before,.intro-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4%;border:1px solid #d6cbbc;pointer-events:none}
.kicker{font:700 clamp(10px,1.05vw,14px)/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--accent);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 18px}
.title-card h1{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(25px,4.7vw,67px);letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.12;margin:0 0 16px}
.title-card .line{height:2px;width:55px;background:var(--accent);margin:5px 0 21px}
.title-card p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.35vw,20px);color:#5c6569;line-height:1.5;margin:0}
.intro-card h2{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,48px);line-height:1.16;margin:0 0 20px}
.intro-card .intro-body{font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,19px);line-height:1.6;color:#455055}
.intro-card .intro-body p{margin:0 0 .7em}
.controls{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;height:64px;background:var(--page);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:22px;font:13px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--soft);z-index:5}
.controls button{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ddd8ce;background:var(--paper);color:#536166;display:grid;place-items:center;font:20px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.controls button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#f0ebdf}
.controls button:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}
.controls button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.count{min-width:45px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .deck{padding:8px 8px 0}
 .slide.painting-card{width:min(calc(100vw - 16px),calc((100dvh - 175px)*1.7768331562))}
 .painting-caption{padding:14px 13px 18px}
 .painting-caption h2{font-size:clamp(14px,3.7vw,19px);line-height:1.3}
 .slide.title-card,.slide.intro-card{width:min(calc(100vw - 16px),calc((100dvh - 140px)*1.52));aspect-ratio:1.52;padding:7% 8%}
 .slide.section-card{width:min(calc(100vw - 16px),calc((100dvh - 140px)*1.52));aspect-ratio:1.52;padding:8% 10%}
 .section-card h2{font-size:clamp(23px,6vw,37px);margin-bottom:17px;line-height:1.15}
 .section-card .section-rule{width:48px}

 .kicker{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:10px}
 .title-card h1{font-size:clamp(20px,5vw,31px);margin-bottom:8px}
 .title-card .line{margin-bottom:12px}
 .title-card p{font-size:clamp(9px,2.35vw,13px);line-height:1.3}
 .intro-card h2{font-size:clamp(18px,4.3vw,26px);margin-bottom:6px}
 .intro-card .intro-body{font-size:clamp(9px,2.2vw,13px);line-height:1.36}
 .intro-card .intro-body p{margin:0 0 .4em}
}
@media(min-height:950px){.deck{padding-top:78px}}
@media(max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape){
 .controls{height:44px}.deck{height:calc(100dvh - 44px)}
 .slide.painting-card{width:min(calc(100vw - 24px),calc((100dvh - 155px)*1.7768331562))}
 .painting-caption{padding:8px 10px 11px}.painting-caption h2{font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vw,18px)}
 .slide.title-card,.slide.intro-card{width:min(calc(100vw - 24px),calc((100dvh - 75px)*1.60))}
 .slide.section-card{width:min(calc(100vw - 24px),calc((100dvh - 75px)*1.60))}
 .section-card h2{font-size:clamp(19px,4vw,44px);margin-bottom:12px}

}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important}}
/* TEXT REFLOW GUARDRAIL: source text is reconstructed before slide authoring.
   No hand-inserted <br> at PDF page wraps; CSS handles display wrapping. */
.slide .kicker,.slide h1,.slide h2,.slide p{white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:normal}
</style></head><body>
<main class="deck" aria-label="Illustrated history slide presentation">
<section class="slide title-card active" aria-label="Title slide" aria-hidden="false">
<div class="kicker">An Illustrated Historical Presentation</div>
<h1>British India: From Company Rule to Crown Rule</h1><div class="line"></div>
<p>Charter Acts of 1833 and 1853 · Government of India Act of 1858 · Indian Councils Act of 1861</p>
</section>
<section class="slide intro-card" aria-label="Introduction slide" aria-hidden="true">
<div class="kicker">Introduction</div><h2>Changing the Machinery of Government</h2>
<div class="intro-body"><p>The Charter Act of 1833 centralized authority and ended the East India Company's commercial activities. The Charter Act of 1853 reshaped legislative functions and introduced competitive recruitment to the civil services.</p>
<p>Following the Revolt of 1857, the Government of India Act of 1858 transferred rule from the Company to the British Crown.</p></div>
</section>
<!-- CLEANED SOURCE ONLY: section headings must be real textbook headings,
     never detached page headers. Do not copy a PDF's hard line breaks here.
     Dedicated LEFT-ALIGNED heading then painting-FIRST cards below. -->
<section class="slide section-card" id="section-1833" aria-label="Section: Charter Act of 1833" aria-hidden="true">
<h2>Charter Act of 1833</h2><div class="section-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</section>
<section class="slide painting-card" id="sample-1" aria-label="Charter Act of 1833 — The Final Step Toward Centralisation in British India" aria-hidden="true">
<figure class="artwork"><img src="data:image/png;base64,
